instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to say in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to say</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: I didn't say that I was hungry.
atoms.b: I didn't ((say)) that I was hungry.

atoms.sound: I just said that I'd like to have some chocolate.
atoms.b: I just ((said)) that I'd like to have some chocolate.

atoms.sound: I have always said that chocolate is my soulfood.
atoms.b: I have always ((said)) that chocolate is my soulfood.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to think in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to think</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: I don't think it is too early for ice cream.
atoms.b: I don't ((think)) it is too early for ice cream.

atoms.sound: I thought the ice cream shop was closed.
atoms.b: I ((thought)) the ice cream shop was closed.

atoms.sound: I have always thought of ice cream as a healthy food.
atoms.b: I have always ((thought)) of ice cream as a healthy food.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to bring in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to bring</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: I always bring sandwiches for lunch.
Today, I brought some pasta from yesterday's dinner.
atoms.b: Today, I ((brought)) some pasta from yesterday's dinner.

atoms.sound: I have never brought pasta before.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to buy in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to buy</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: Today I want to buy sweets.
I haven't bought sweets for a while.
atoms.b: I haven't ((bought)) sweets for a while.
